answer_1.quote: we introduce a new prompt template that tasks the model to describe a concept in natural language... we explore whether these mean representations, which theoretically capture language-independent concepts, can be described by the model in natural language as effectively as concepts expressed in a single language.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates definitions of concepts in a target language based on patched latent representations from source prompts in various languages.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the different definitions, we use the sentence-transformers library to run paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2, a semantic similarity model... we compute the similarity score between embeddings of the definition and the mean embedding of the ground truth definitions.
